messages: Hi Suresh, can you confirm the quantity ready at your Nagpur yard and your best rate?
Hello sir. I have 120 MT HMS 1&2 ready. Rate ₹34,800/MT, loading from Nagpur.
Tata's ceiling is ₹34,500. Can you do ₹34,500 if we lift all 120 MT this week?
Okay sir ₹34,500/MT works for the full 120 MT. We can dispatch within 3 days.
Noted. Capturing the agreed terms for the Recykal coordination team. 📝

screens.description: ZoAi records the agreed terms Once the deal is closed, ZoAi posts a structured Deal Summary into the group. This becomes the single source of truth the procurement team uses to raise the PO.

messages: Deal Summary ✅ Supplier: Om Metal Aggregators Material: MS Scrap HMS 1&2 Quantity: 120 MT Final Rate: ₹34,500 / MT Order Value: ₹41,40,000 Dispatch: Within 3 days Delivery: Tata Steel Plant, Jamshedpur Payment: Within 3 days of GRN Recykal will raise the Purchase Order shortly.
Great. Raising the PO now — you will receive it on WhatsApp for acknowledgement.
